title: There’s just a few more days to get ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and more for just $60 for life
excerpt: Why settle for just one AI perspective?
content_html:
TL;DR: Get lifetime access to 20+ AI models, side-by-side comparisons, AI image generation, and unlimited monthly messages (subject to fair use) for $59.97 through Oct. 15.

Credit: ChatPlayground AI

$59.97
$619 Save $559.03

One AI model might nail your prompt, while another offers a completely different approach. Why choose just one without seeing what the others can do? ChatPlayground AI’s Unlimited Plan is just $59.97 (reg. $619) through Oct. 15 during the extended Deal Days sale, giving you lifetime access to 20+ AI models in one workspace.

ChatPlayground AI brings ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, Perplexity, and more together in a single interface. Enter a prompt once, compare responses side by side, and decide which answer works best for your project.

That’s very useful when you’re drafting content, brainstorming ideas, writing code, or working through a complicated question. Rather than relying on one model’s response, you can see how several approach the same task.

And there’s more here than a collection of chatbots.

Upload PDFs and images to ask questions about your files, use built-in prompt engineering tools to refine your requests, or generate AI images without leaving the platform. Saved chat history also makes it easy to revisit previous conversations and pick up where you left off.

The Unlimited Plan includes unlimited monthly messages (subject to a fair-use policy), plus priority customer support and early access to new features and future models. Available models are regularly updated and may change.

For anyone who regularly experiments with different AI tools, having everything in one place is a practical way to simplify the process.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get lifetime access to ChatPlayground AI’s Unlimited Plan for a one-time $59.97 payment (reg. $619) through Oct. 15 and put multiple AI perspectives to work with one purchase.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
